name: HUD and info
description: Information panels and warnings: hit feedback, hit counts, armour durability, health and enemy warnings, TPS, lagbacks, invulnerability, inventory counts, session stats, ping, detector hints, item drops and the block you aim at. Client-side only.

addons.HitMarker: Flashes a cross on the crosshair when one of your hits lands.
addons.HitSound: Plays a sound when one of your hits lands, and another on a kill. Pick the sounds, volume and pitch.
addons.HitCounter: Counts the hits you land and take in the current fight, and resets after a quiet period.
addons.ArmorStatus: Panel with the durability of your armour and held item, and the nearest player's.
addons.HealthWarning: Flashes the screen, plays a sound and turns the HUD panel red when your health drops below a limit.
addons.EnemyWarning: Warns when a player who is not on your friend list comes within a chosen distance. Ignores players the AntiBot filters.
addons.TpsMeter: Estimates the server TPS from the time updates it sends, and shows it red below 18.
addons.LagbackAlert: Alerts when the server pulls you back to another position, with the distance.
addons.InvulnTimer: Shows the invulnerability time left on the entity you last hit.
addons.ItemCounter: Counts blocks, arrows, ender pearls and golden apples in your inventory.
addons.SessionStats: Kills, deaths, K/D and time played this session, counted from chat.
addons.PingWarning: Shows your ping, red while it is above a limit.
addons.ItemAlerts: Chat alert when chosen items are dropped near you, with a short HUD line.
addons.BlockInfo: Shows the block under your crosshair, its hardness and an approximate break time.
addons.WeaponCompare: Shows the held weapon's damage next to the best one in your inventory, and the slot to switch to.
addons.KnockbackMeter: Shows how hard the last hit you took, and the last one you gave, pushed.
addons.BowCharge: Shows the bow charge percentage while you draw.
addons.FallDistance: Shows how far you have fallen since you last touched the ground.
addons.Speedometer: Shows your horizontal speed in blocks per second.
addons.StateIcons: Labels for sprinting, sneaking, blocking, using and airborne.
addons.NearbyCount: Counts players nearby, split into teammates and enemies.
addons.AfkDetector: Lists players who have stood still for a long time.
addons.ReachDisplay: Shows the distance to the last entity you attacked.
addons.MemoryUsage: Shows the memory the game is using, in megabytes.
